The '''mutant womprat''' was a large [[Womp rat/Legends|womp rat]] that lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="SSW" /> It was believed to be the result of unspecified radiation testing carried out at a secret [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] base. It escaped the laboratory and terrorized [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] for months prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="Secrets" />

==Behind the scenes==
The mutant womprat appears in the game ''[[Super Star Wars]]'' as boss of "Level 5, Part II: Land of the Banthas," where it is fought by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. The creature was accompanied by several smaller womp rats.<ref name="SSW" />
[[File:Mutantrat.jpg|thumb|242px|Luke Skywalker fighting a mutant womprat]]
